record.question: Alidade is used in—
record.explanation: An alidade supplies the sight line and plotting edge used in plane-table surveying. It is an accessory of plane tabling. Reference: https://bharatskills.gov.in/pdf/Curriculum/CTS/English/Surveyor.pdf; https://www.fao.org/fishery/static/FAO_Training/FAO_Training/General/x6707e/x6707e07.htm.
